title: Fox-Bats
hook: Player-safe note: Small fox-bats sleep under signs, steal shiny route tokens, and may tuck into a traveler's coat when the forest briefly feels kind.

blocks.label: Observed Form
blocks.body: Give one concrete visual, one sound or texture, and one sign of who has used or neglected it.

blocks.label: Behavior
blocks.body: Small fox-bats sleep under signs, steal shiny route tokens, and may tuck into a traveler's coat when the forest briefly feels kind.; show instinct first through distance, posture, scent, and how the creature protects what is close to it.

blocks.label: Warning Signs
blocks.body: Being surrounded, misread as a monster, or driven toward Sablewood™ Logistics Preserve, Sablewood Hope Moments, Halython's Fox-Bat Companion by noise and haste.

affordances: Give it distance before deciding it is hostile.
Read posture, tracks, and what it is protecting.
